game.summary: Implemented economy-online in the worktree (uncommitted, as instructed). (0) Hold grace: WORLD_HOLD_GRACE_FRAMES=45 in the protocol; InputGate.holdButtonsAt bridges gaps up to 750 ms for interact/fruit only in the room's hold reads (stepChannels, stepFruits, stepClaim); step() and the encounter rules keep the 250 ms lapse; per-player gapsBridged/holdsLapsed in MatchRoom.inputDiagnostics, lapses logged. (1) supplySites(map) in apps/server/src/supply.ts: 4 crates at (39,41),(71,41),(39,69),(71,69); ledger supply caches; crateClaims gives a crate to the lowest player id touching it; sight-filtered crates map. (2) Protocol v11 buy-tonic/tonic-purchase/use-tonic/tonic-used; ShopBook per kind; purchases decided on the tick (not-at-dock, then ledger purchase under tonic:<id>); chargeRumor now charges rumor:<id>. (3) Tonic: ShipState.tonicUntil in the simulation state/hash; drunk on tick t, steps t+1..t+240 cap at 39+tonicSpeedBonus (=43), every step clamps to its cap so t+241 is 39; useTonic gets atSea and grappled (defender of a pending windup). (5) Web: ShopPanel (B), TonicKey (T, ignores repeat), purse tonic count/timer/+10% speed, #hud data-max-speed, crate markers. (8) Pending rumors answered match-ended at the end; a rumor id retried for another type is refused duplicate; intel privacy test now checks decoded state and messages structurally. (9) docs/economy-online-coverage.md: 144 rows (141 tested by deleting each branch on scratch copies, 3 equivalent). (10) docs/architecture.md 'Economy in the room' (~325 words) and the hold-grace rule. Checks run here from this tree after npm ci: npm run typecheck (pass); npm run test:unit (69 files, 1427 tests pass); npm run test:integration (24 files, 159 tests pass, 206 s wall); npm run build (pass, smoke passed); full Playwright suite with JSON report (17 passed, 475 s) and the pinned check-report command: all 14 scenarios ok, including shop-and-tonic.
open_assumptions: A ship already at full speed accelerates by the tuning's 3 on tick t+1 (39 -> 42) and moves 43 sub-units per tick on t+2..t+240; the integration and unit tests assert exactly that (the cap is 43 for the steps of t+1..t+240), and 39 again from t+241 (clamped).

Tonic purchases or drinks still waiting when the match ends are answered not-in-play (rumors get the new match-ended); a drink/purchase refused by the room keeps the room's last 16 refusals per kind, like the rumor book.
The ledger's activeTonic window (ticks t..t+239) is one tick earlier than the simulation's boosted steps (t+1..t+240), as the task specifies; the HUD timer follows the simulation's tonicUntil.
Any ship touching a crate claims it; ships held for a duel or respawn are not filtered out because they cannot move onto one (that branch was removed while building the coverage table).
